reason: I might throw the free 40 at it, but my guys' nota from the supply shop are scribbled in pencil, half in Indonesian shorthand, and often faded. If I still have to check every row by hand, it saves me nothing and I won't pay for it.
objection: It will misread the handwritten nota, the item names and the amounts, and I'll end up fixing the sheet myself. Then it's just another subscription I cancel.
would_change_my_mind: Running my own old chat archive through the free trial and seeing it get the handwritten supply-shop nota right, amounts and totals, with almost nothing for me to fix.
